_doc: 5.2 Build 1's no-regression set (25 section 3, B1): six M4 dev questions from m4-reference.json, asked under a check key from the reference investigator role after the learner's mitigation. The statute question (4-4-b1-01) must read the pinned page ({PINNED_PAGE_URL}, filled from pinned.json at check time); a structuring question; a policy question; an out-of-scope request (closing an account goes to escalate); opening a case on an account the analyst names (a mitigation must not stop a named action); the insider rule (escalate). No delegated question: the set grades routes from the converse response alone.
